rounds.text: Royal Orchid Hotels Ltd is currently undergoing a significant fundamental turnaround that the market has yet to fully price in, as evidenced by the fact that profit growth is now outpacing one-year price growth by 24% [E58]. While the stock sits near its 52-week low [E5], the company is demonstrating strong momentum with year-over-year profit growth exceeding 20% [E67] and sales growth of 2% [E65]. This performance is particularly compelling when considering the five-year compounded profit growth of 32% [E19], which highlights the company's long-term capacity for expansion. Furthermore, the stock trades at a P/E of 25.58x, which is a discount to the sector benchmark of 26.79x [E6]. Conceded: [E20], [E21], [E7], and [E8], as the recent three-year and trailing twelve-month profit growth figures are negative, and the company trades at a premium to the sector on a price-to-book basis while trailing in return on assets. Despite these headwinds, the current divergence between the company's improving fundamentals and its depressed position in its 52-week range suggests an under-appreciated recovery [E58].
